title: Phone-executed prop entries (breakout_2) submit the ticket's nominal size with no dd-floor cushion check
note: MEASURED 2026-11-05 (lane session_01AFoLuKeQu3QVQ3hxYKt2vn, public /api/bot/prop reads plus code at origin/main). Instance: ticket prop-manual-8468ab1f682f (breakout_2, trend_donchian_eth_prop ETH long, 11-04 15:00Z). The ticket text said 'DO NOT PLACE AT THE SUGGESTED SIZE (risk $17.50 vs $11.94 remaining)'. The phone live-submitted 0.29 ETH, entry 2379.36, SL 2319.40: risk at stop 0.29 x 59.96 = $17.39. Balance 4861.94, static floor 4850, so a stop-out ends at ~4844.5 and permanently disables the account. CAUSE (code, not a guess): (1) the ticket's qty is the nominal suggested size. prop_risk_gate at emit runs in PROP_TICKET_RISK_GATE_MODE annotate (the module default): it adds the caveat text and leaves size unchanged. The ticket's risk_usd stayed 17.5, so enforce did not cap it. The live VM env value was not read. (2) The phone path src/prop/phone_executor.py (claim_next -> verify_readback/check_readback -> redeem_go_token) never calls prop_risk_gate.grade_ticket_risk or prop_executor.evaluate_guards. check_readback only verifies the form against ticket.qty, and even refuses a qty a full step or more below it. So neither the phone nor a human following the form could downsize. By contrast, the VM executor path (prop_executor.evaluate_guards, ~L544) grades the cushion in ENFORCE 'whatever the global default' and treats exceeds_cushion as a breach. The phone path is the one entry path without it. PROPOSED FIX (Tier 3, operator): before issuing a LIVE go-token (verify_readback/redeem_go_token, or at claim_next), run the same grade_ticket_risk the VM executor runs against the latest account_status snapshot. exceeds_cushion refuses; cushion_unknown counts as could-not-look. Alternatively, size the ticket to the cushion at emit for phone accounts. Interim: with $11.94 to the floor, ANY normal-size breakout_2 ticket can end the account. PR #23154 (pull trend_donchian_eth_prop from the prop rosters) stops this leg only. Closes when a phone-account ticket graded exceeds_cushion is observed refused before a go-token. 2026-11-05 ~10:59Z OPERATOR TIER-3 DECISION (popup, relayed by Manager Session 2026-11-05a), verbatim: "Merge, breakout_2 on report (Rec.)". Context, operator this week: "don't worry about account breach, it's a small test account and we'll just buy another one". Built in PR #23252. phone_executor.verify_readback grades the cushion via live_cushion_refusals before any LIVE go-token, with risk = qty*|price-sl| from the verified form. HARD refusals in every mode: cushion_unknown, or a risk not computable from the form. breakout_2 is set to risk.breach_guards: report (config/accounts.yaml), so its exceeds_cushion PINGS and the submit proceeds. Closes when the next breakout_2 LIVE phone submit is observed with a cushion ping (or a within-cushion grade) and the submit going ahead. 2026-11-06 ~10:40Z lane PROP-SIZE-EXCEEDS-DD-CUSHION (dispatched by Manager Session 2026-11-06a). VERDICT (a): observation only; no Tier-3 change, no PR. EVIDENCE: (1) MERGED+DEPLOYED, NOT OBSERVED: live_cushion_refusals (phone_executor.verify_readback) is on main via fedfbe40b, an ancestor of the running web-api sha df8d5446b and the trader sha 3df661599 (/api/diag/version 10:34Z); the /phone/verify route is served by the web API (src/web/api/routers/prop.py:358). accounts.yaml breakout_2.risk.breach_guards=report is on main. (2) SIZE IS NOW $10/ticket, not $17.50: PR #23525 (858c3be4d, deployed in both shas) set sizing.flat.per_leg_risk_usd 10 for trend_donchian_eth_4h/sol_4h under the operator's 'Baseline at min size (Rec.)' exception. breakout_2 roster = [trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_sol_4h]. (3) LIVE GRADE: /api/bot/prop/status 10:3xZ: balance 4861.94, distance_to_dd_floor_after_open_risk 11.94, freshness ok (5.9h of 24h), no open positions, daily distance null (day_pnl realized_unreported). grade_ticket_risk on those values: $10 -> within_cushion; $11.94/$17 -> exceeds_cushion (computed locally). qty_step 0.01 (prop_platforms.yaml) moves risk by <=~$0.60 on ETH, so the next ticket grades WITHIN and submits; after one loss the next grades EXCEEDS -> ping, submit proceeds (operator's accepted breach). WHY NOT (b) cap-to-cushion: not data-settled and contradicts two operator records -- report mode (11-05 10:59Z) and min-size baseline (11-05 18:55Z); $10 = SizingConfig.min_risk_usd, the sizer's floor; and risking the whole cushion still breaches on a stop (grade uses >=), so a cap cannot save the account, only shrink the baseline below the firm min the operator chose. NOTE: comms/prop_survival/breakout_2.json does not exist; the records are per leg (comms/prop_survival/trend_donchian_{eth,sol}_4h.json, each carrying operator_exception kind=baseline). LATENT (as designed, not a defect): a snapshot older than status_max_age_hours 24 grades cushion_unknown and HARD-refuses the live go-token -- the phone's account_status post must stay <24h old. OBSERVATION READ for the close: no breakout_2 ticket since 2026-11-05 06:04Z (last 100 of /api/bot/prop/tickets). On the next breakout_2 LIVE ticket read /api/bot/prop/tickets meta.phone.go (mode live, form qty/price/sl -> risk) + meta.phone.verify.ok and /api/bot/prop/status rule_distance at that time; WITHIN grade is not written to meta (only inferable from form risk vs cushion), EXCEEDS leaves a 'breach_guards=report, submit proceeds' ping.
